LanguageData.ReactorSlag_CoolingDaysDesc: How long a spilled core glows before it goes cold. Light and halo shrink and redden over this time.
LanguageData.ReactorSlag_DrawHaloDesc: The soft glow drawn over a hot pool. The light it casts on the ground stays either way.
LanguageData.ReactorSlag_GroundScarDesc: With Odyssey, a cooled pool turns its centre into cooled lava. Only natural ground: never floors, water or growing zones.
